user.title: Your tank
user.description: Step 1 of 7. Name the tank and give its two volumes. Every later step can be skipped: Claude can fill in the rest in a conversation.

data.volume_litres: What's the volume of your tank?
data.dosing_volume_litres: What's the volume of water in your tank?

data_description.tank_name: What you call the tank, for example Office tank.
data_description.volume_litres: In litres, as given on the box or by the maker.
data_description.dosing_volume_litres: In litres. Gravel, rocks and wood take up space, so this is less than the volume of the tank. Doses are worked out for this volume. If you don't know it, use about 10% less than the volume of the tank.
data_description.temperature_c: The target temperature, in °C. Leave empty if you don't know it.
data_description.notes: Anything Claude should know about the tank, in your own words.

reconfigure.title: Change your tank
reconfigure.description: The old values stay in the history.

how.title: Go on, or leave it to Claude
how.description: Add the water, products, contents, light and reminders now, or finish and let Claude ask about them in a conversation.

water.title: Tap water
water.description: Step 2 of 7. The values of the water you fill the tank with, from your water supplier or a test. Leave everything empty to skip.

products.title: Products
products.description: Step 3 of 7. Fertilisers, water conditioners and other products the tank gets. Added: {added}

add_product.title: Add a product
add_product.description: Give the dose from the label to have doses worked out for your tank.

data_description.label_amount_ml: The dose on the label, in ml. Give both label values or neither.
data_description.label_per_litres: The volume of water the label dose is for, in litres.
data_description.label_frequency: How often the label says to dose, for example weekly.
data_description.your_dose: The dose you use, in your own words, if it is not the label dose.

contents.title: Contents
contents.description: Step 4 of 7. Plants, fish, rocks, wood and anything else in the tank. Added: {added}

data_description.where: Where it sits in the tank, for example back left.

light.title: Light
light.description: Step 5 of 7. TankKeeper can set the helpers an automation runs the tank light from.

add_light.title: Add the light
add_light.description: An automation runs the light from helpers. TankKeeper sets the helpers to the schedule.

data_description.entity_id: The light or switch that powers the tank light.
data_description.control: On/off works with a switch. Dimmable and colour need a light entity.
data_description.on: When the light turns on each day.
data_description.off: When the light turns off, on the same day.
data_description.brightness_pct: Dimmable and colour lights only. Leave empty to leave the brightness helper as it is.
data_description.ramp_minutes: Dimmable and colour lights only. Minutes to fade in at on and fade out at off.
data_description.automation: The automation that runs the light from the helpers. TankKeeper never switches the light itself.
data_description.on_helper: A time-only input_datetime the automation turns the light on at. TankKeeper sets it to the on time.
data_description.off_helper: A time-only input_datetime the automation turns the light off at. TankKeeper sets it to the off time.
data_description.brightness_helper: An input_number the automation reads the brightness from. Needed for a brightness.
data_description.ramp_helper: An input_number the automation reads the ramp in minutes from. Needed for a ramp.

reminders.title: Reminders
reminders.description: Step 6 of 7. TankKeeper can send reminders for tasks and doses, with Complete and Skip buttons.

set_reminders.title: Reminders
set_reminders.description: Which devices get reminders, and when.

data_description.notify: Notify services that get a reminder with Complete and Skip buttons. Use the Home Assistant app on a phone or tablet for the buttons.
data_description.task_time: When tasks are due. Open tasks from the last week are followed up at this time.
data_description.dose_time: When doses are due when no light is set. With a light, doses are due when the light turns on.
data_description.resend_time: When tasks still open today are sent again.
data_description.status_notify: Notify services that get a message when the status changes to Watch or Act, once when it is back on course, and when a proposal is still waiting.

claude.title: Claude
claude.description: Step 7 of 7. Talk to your tank in Assist through Claude, and have Claude review it. Claude records what you tell it. Other changes need your yes, in the conversation or the panel.

set_claude.title: Claude
set_claude.description: The Anthropic API key stays in the Anthropic integration. TankKeeper never asks for it.

data_description.agent: The agent TankKeeper's Assist agent passes chat to, for example Claude from the Anthropic integration. Its chat model is set in that integration.
data_description.ai_task: Writes Claude's comments on reviews. Its model is set in the Anthropic integration; a cheaper one than the chat model is an option.
data_description.review_on: The events that start a review. Events close together give one review.
data_description.comments: Each comment is one call to the AI task entity, which uses Anthropic credits.
data_description.daily_time: Also review once a day at this time. Leave empty for no daily review.
data_description.daily_cap: The most Claude comments in a day. Reviews past it have only the rules result.

error.dosing_above_volume: The volume of water can't be larger than the volume of the tank.
error.label_dose_incomplete: The label dose needs both the dose in ml and the volume of water it is for.

abort.not_loaded: TankKeeper isn't running. Fix the problem shown on the integration, then try again.

menu_options.one_day: Change a light for one day

tank.title: Tank
tank.description: The tank's name, volumes, temperature and notes. A field left empty is cleared. The old details stay in the history.

water.title: [%key:component::tankkeeper::config::step::water::title%]
water.description: The values of the water you fill the tank with, from your water supplier or a test. A field left empty is cleared. The old values stay in the history.

products.title: [%key:component::tankkeeper::config::step::products::title%]
products.description: Fertilisers, water conditioners and other products the tank gets. In use: {listed}

data_description.links: Web pages about the product, such as the maker's page or the label.

edit_product.title: Change a product
edit_product.description: A field left empty is cleared. The old details stay in the history.

data_description.links: Web pages about the product, such as the maker's page or the label.

remove_product.title: Stop using a product
remove_product.description: The product stays in the records with today's date.

contents.title: [%key:component::tankkeeper::config::step::contents::title%]
contents.description: Plants, fish, rocks, wood and anything else in the tank. In the tank: {listed}

data_description.added: The day it went into the tank. Left empty, it is today for something new and stays the same for a change.

edit_content.title: Change something in the tank
edit_content.description: A field left empty is cleared. The old details stay in the history.

data_description.added: The day it went into the tank. Left empty, it is today for something new and stays the same for a change.

remove_content.title: Take something out
remove_content.description: The item stays in the records with today's date.

reminders.title: Reminders
reminders.description: Which devices get reminders, and when. The old settings stay in the history.

data_description.notify: Notify services that get a reminder with Complete and Skip buttons. Use the Home Assistant app on a phone or tablet for the buttons.
data_description.task_time: When tasks are due. Open tasks from the last week are followed up at this time.
data_description.dose_time: When doses are due when no light is set. With a light, doses are due when the light turns on.
data_description.resend_time: When tasks still open today are sent again.
data_description.status_notify: Notify services that get a message when the status changes to Watch or Act, once when it is back on course, and when a proposal is still waiting.

rules.title: Rules and status
rules.description: The limits the rules use to set the status, and whether the tank is cycling. The old settings stay in the history.

data_description.stage: Cycling turns on the pH and cycle stalled rules. Leave empty when not known.
data_description.nitrogen_watch: A tank reading above this, in ppm, is Watch.
data_description.nitrogen_act: A tank reading above this, in ppm, is Act.
data_description.ph_watch: A pH under this while cycling is Watch.
data_description.ph_act: A pH under this while cycling is Act.
data_description.stall_watch_days: Days of the same ammonia reading with no nitrite that are Watch.
data_description.stall_act_days: Days of the same ammonia reading with no nitrite that are Act.
data_description.test_watch_days: Days a planned test is late for Watch.
data_description.test_act_days: Days a planned test is late for Act.
data_description.skip_watch: Doses of one product skipped in a row for Watch.
data_description.skip_act: Doses of one product skipped in a row for Act.
data_description.plan_watch_days: Days left in the plan for Watch.
data_description.plan_act_days: Days left in the plan for Act.

claude.title: Claude
claude.description: The agent TankKeeper chats through, and when Claude reviews the tank. The old settings stay in the history.

data_description.agent: The agent TankKeeper's Assist agent passes chat to, for example Claude from the Anthropic integration. Its chat model is set in that integration.
data_description.ai_task: Writes Claude's comments on reviews. Its model is set in the Anthropic integration; a cheaper one than the chat model is an option.
data_description.review_on: The events that start a review. Events close together give one review.
data_description.comments: Each comment is one call to the AI task entity, which uses Anthropic credits.
data_description.daily_time: Also review once a day at this time. Leave empty for no daily review.
data_description.daily_cap: The most Claude comments in a day. Reviews past it have only the rules result.

camera.title: Camera
camera.description: A camera, for example a Tapo C100, sends a photo of the tank to Claude, who looks for problems. Photos stay in config/tankkeeper/photos and go only to the AI task entity, so to Anthropic. Each check is one call to the AI task entity, uses Anthropic credits and counts toward the comments a day.

data_description.camera: The camera entity that sees the tank. Leave empty for no photo checks.
data_description.check_time: Check once a day at this time, only while a light is on. Leave empty for no daily check.
data_description.after_test: Also check when a water test is recorded.
data_description.alerts: Send issues from daily and after-test checks to the status alert devices, with the photo.
data_description.keep_days: Days to keep photos. Open issues and the latest checks are always kept.

add_light.title: Add a light
add_light.description: An automation runs the light from helpers. TankKeeper sets the helpers to the schedule. The change applies straight away.

data_description.entity_id: The light or switch that powers the tank light.
data_description.control: On/off works with a switch. Dimmable and colour need a light entity.
data_description.on: When the light turns on each day.
data_description.off: When the light turns off, on the same day.
data_description.brightness_pct: Dimmable and colour lights only. Leave empty to leave the brightness helper as it is.
data_description.ramp_minutes: Dimmable and colour lights only. Minutes to fade in at on and fade out at off.
data_description.automation: The automation that runs the light from the helpers. TankKeeper never switches the light itself.
data_description.on_helper: A time-only input_datetime the automation turns the light on at. TankKeeper sets it to the on time.
data_description.off_helper: A time-only input_datetime the automation turns the light off at. TankKeeper sets it to the off time.
data_description.brightness_helper: An input_number the automation reads the brightness from. Needed for a brightness.
data_description.ramp_helper: An input_number the automation reads the ramp in minutes from. Needed for a ramp.

edit_light.title: Change a light
edit_light.description: The change applies straight away. The old settings stay in the history.

data_description.control: On/off works with a switch. Dimmable and colour need a light entity.
data_description.on: When the light turns on each day.
data_description.off: When the light turns off, on the same day.
data_description.brightness_pct: Dimmable and colour lights only. Leave empty to leave the brightness helper as it is.
data_description.ramp_minutes: Dimmable and colour lights only. Minutes to fade in at on and fade out at off.
data_description.automation: The automation that runs the light from the helpers. TankKeeper never switches the light itself.
data_description.on_helper: A time-only input_datetime the automation turns the light on at. TankKeeper sets it to the on time.
data_description.off_helper: A time-only input_datetime the automation turns the light off at. TankKeeper sets it to the off time.
data_description.brightness_helper: An input_number the automation reads the brightness from. Needed for a brightness.
data_description.ramp_helper: An input_number the automation reads the ramp in minutes from. Needed for a ramp.

one_day.title: Change a light for one day
one_day.description: The light goes back to its schedule the next day. Leave the brightness empty to keep it.

remove_light.title: Remove a light
remove_light.description: TankKeeper stops switching the light. Its history stays.

repeat_not_supported.message: TankKeeper tasks can't repeat. Add one task for each day

light_problem.title: The light {model} may not follow its schedule
light_problem.description: {problems} An automation runs the light from its helpers; TankKeeper only sets the helpers. The problem clears by itself when it is fixed.
